CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  January 18, 2022

 The audio and video recording of the meeting is available here: PC Meeting – January 18, 2022
  (Audio) / PC Meeting – January 18, 2022 (Video).m4a

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Gardea

  Mojarro, Wang, and Garcia arrived at 7:01 P.M.

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Scott
  Quyle, Associate Planner; Alondra Espinosa, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda Items.

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-12 (7:02 P.M.)
  • 1420 South 3rd Street
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development
  Permit PD-21-12 to develop a 3-story, 4-unit, apartment
  complex on a site of approximately 10,538 square feet located
  in the R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone. (This item is
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Continue to February 7, 2022.
  •  Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided the Staff presentation.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Agenda Item 1 to the February 7, 2022, regular
  meeting of the Planning Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  1
  01/18/2022
   •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

AGENDA
ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-30, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-21-12, VARIANCE VAR-21-11, VARIANCE VAR-21-17 AND
  VARIANCE VAR-21-18 (7:04 P.M.)
  • 2505 West Valley Boulevard
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development
  Permit, Conditional Use Permit, and Variance to construct an
  approximate 753 square foot exterior covered patio for outdoor
  dining for an existing restaurant on a site approximate land area
  of 21,531 square feet located at 2505 West Valley Boulevard in
  the VSP (Valley Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan) zone. The
  applicant has requested three (3) Variances to reduce the
  number of required on-site parking spaces, to waive the
  requirement for an 8-foot landscape bed along West Valley
  Boulevard and Elm Street, and for a reduction in parking
  backup standards. (This item is exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-09, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-21-30, Conditional Use
  Permit CUP-21-12, Variance VAR-21-11, Variance VAR-21-17,
  and Variance VAR-21-18, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  •  Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Omar Hernandez and Encarnacion Gutierrez, the Applicants, were
  available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Tai Costa (Alhambra Chamber of Commerce)
  •  The public hearing was reopened then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  2.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  2
  01/18/2022
   Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  TENATIVE PARCEL MAP TPM-21-01 (7:23 P.M.)
  • 301 South Atlantic Boulevard
  • Request: This is an application for a Tentative Parcel Map TPM-
  21-01 to subdivide an existing parcel of 30,000 square feet into
  two parcels of 13,337.50 square feet and 16,662.50 square feet
  located in the CPD (Commercial Planned Development) zone.
  (This item is exempt from the California Environmental Quality
  Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-08, approving
  Tentative Parcel Map TPM-21-01, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  •  Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Brandy Yamamoto, the Applicant, was available to answer
  questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 3.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT AMD-21-02 (7:44 P.M.)
  • All properties within the Downtown Revitalization District
  • Request: This is a proposed Zone Text Amendment, AMD-21-
  02, for an Amendment to Chapter 23.27 (Downtown
  Revitalization District) of the Alhambra Municipal Code
  pertaining to regulations and standards related to affordable
  housing developments.  (This item is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-06,
  recommending that the City Council adopt a Resolution
  approving Zone Text Amendment AMD-21-02 for an
  Amendment to Chapter 23.27 (Downtown Revitalization
  District) of the Alhambra Municipal Code pertaining to
  regulations and standards related to affordable housing
  developments.
  3
  01/18/2022
   •  Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided the Staff presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon

MOTION:
  •  Moved to recommend approval of Agenda Item 4 to City Council with the
  amendment that there be a percentage requirement for very low income
  and low income.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Wang, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
  •  The motion failed by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-5-0-0
  Ayes:  Mojarro, Olson, Sahu, Wang, Gardea
  Noes:  Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

MOTION:
  •  Moved to recommend approval of Agenda Item 4 to City Council.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-2-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  Mojarro, Wang
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

  •  Recess at 9:16 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 9:21 P.M.

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT AMD-21-03 (9:21 P.M.)
  • Citywide
  • Request: This is a proposed Zone Text Amendment, AMD-21-
  03, for an Amendment to Chapter 23.08 of the Alhambra
  Municipal Code pertaining to Certificates of Occupancy. (This
  item is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-04,
  recommending that the City Council adopt a Resolution
  approving Zone Text Amendment, AMD-21-03, for an
  Amendment to Chapter 23.08 of the Alhambra Municipal Code
  pertaining to Certificates of Occupancy.
  •  Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  •  The public hearing was opened then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Tai Costa (Alhambra Chamber of Commerce)
  4
  01/18/2022
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Agenda Item 5 to the February 7, 2022, regular
  meeting of the Planning Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

G.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 6:  ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS (9:54 P.M.)
  • Request: This is an informational report to provide the Planning
  Commission with a general overview on Accessory Dwelling
  Unit (“ADU”) applications submitted to the City regarding the
  number of ADU applications submitted to the City, types of
  ADU’s requested, the status of ADU applications, and location
  of all ADU’s in Alhambra. This update covers July to December
  2021. (This item is exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act.)
  •  Recommended Action: Planning Commission receive and file
  this informational report.
  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso provided the Staff presentation.

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso informed the Commission that a Historic
  Preservation community meeting is scheduled for the coming week.

H.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Lewis McCammon commented that ADU’s will benefit the community in the long run.
  After the certificates of occupancy are completed, 3-6 months later, ask the applicants
  how the ADU was utilized. With the land costs taken care of, the units may come in at
  moderate or lower, helping to meet the housing element goals. (10:16 P.M.)
  •

I.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS/ANNOUNCEMENTS:

  •  Commissioner Wang followed up with the public comment regarding a survey at the
  end of the ADU process to collect data. (10:20 P.M.)
  •  Commissioner Ho agreed that it is good to collect data, but the use of the ADU isn’t
  the business of the City, and the providing information should be voluntary. It’s
  important to know why we are collecting the data. (10:20 P.M.)

  5
  01/18/2022
 J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 10:22 P.M. to Monday,
  February 7, 2022, at 7:00 P.M.
